calls.notes: Divya Menon reached out — their cloud infrastructure costs are 40% over budget due to unoptimized deployments. Strong pain. In Call 1, we proactively asked: who will champion this internally, who has budget authority, and who in finance needs to sign off. Got three names: Divya (champion), Prakash Iyer (VP Eng, budget), Sunita Roy (Finance BP). Scheduled separate calls with Prakash and Sunita.

Separate call with Prakash Iyer. Tailored pitch entirely around engineering velocity and cost reduction — his two core KPIs. He responded very well. He mentioned AWS Cost Explorer as something they currently use but said it was insufficient. We sent a same-day comparison showing our depth vs AWS Cost Explorer.

Group call — Divya, Prakash, and Sunita. We presented consolidated value story addressing each person's priority. Sunita asked about ROI — we had the custom calculator ready. Prakash proposed a 30-day pilot with 3 agreed success metrics: 20% cost reduction, zero deployment failures, engineer hours saved. We accepted immediately with formal success criteria doc.

Pilot kickoff meeting. Pilot formally started today with signed success criteria document. Divya and her team onboarded in under 2 hours — our implementation team was ready. Prakash said he appreciated the speed. Weekly check-ins scheduled for pilot duration. Energy is very high.
